notes.text: The linked Bavli names Rava bar Ittai as the questioner and Rav Idi bar Avin as the addressee. Rava asks about two statements of Shmuel. [Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3191&lang=en) heads the name Rabbah bar Ittai and refers to his Rava bar Ihi notice.
